priorityDefinitions.P0: Safety, data integrity, permissions or dependency/release gate; highest priority within its eligible sprint.
priorityDefinitions.P2: R2 extension after approval and R1 evidence.
priorityDefinitions.P3: R3 extension after approval; not in first release.

sprintScheduling: Dependency-ordered milestones. Calendar dates/capacity/estimates are not assigned until scope and reviewer/environment availability are confirmed. A later-sprint P0 never jumps its prerequisites.

taskStatusDefinitions.done: Mapped output verified; any required task-specific review recorded. FP-001 completion is planning only, not implementation approval.
taskStatusDefinitions.in-review: Mapping work being checked; not implementation.
taskStatusDefinitions.awaiting-scope-approval: Mapped but not authorized to execute yet.
taskStatusDefinitions.future-gated: Later action requiring explicit milestone/action approval.
taskStatusDefinitions.planned: Authorized preparation phase; dependencies/reviews still apply.
taskStatusDefinitions.in-progress: Authorized local preparation or engineering is underway; task-specific verification and external gates may remain.
taskStatusDefinitions.draft-awaiting-review: Preparation output complete; acceptance is pending. Not approved for implementation or live use.
taskStatusDefinitions.awaiting-external-acceptance: Review dossier prepared; actual required feedback/sign-off or build decision is pending. Task is not accepted/done.

approvalSemantics: approvalRefs identify inputs, reviews and permissions touched by a task. Inputs/reviews may be delivered at task completion; permissions for consequential actions must precede that action. A06 precedes S1–S2, G2 plus A12 precedes S3–S5. A13–A19 require exact scope as applicable. A20/A21 separate preparation/build/enablement checkpoints.

tasks.title: Create and verify independent local recovery archive
tasks.acceptance: Create source/docs archive plus Git bundle outside the implementation checkout in an ignored recovery directory; manifest/checksums verified. Exclude secrets, client exports, dependencies and generated caches. Same-device copy is not off-device disaster protection.

tasks.title: Inventory configuration and data recovery coverage
tasks.acceptance: Record environment-variable names only, ignored-file categories, assets, local browser-storage use and hosted dependencies; identify gaps. No secret or real-client-data export. Document secure owner-managed configuration recovery.

tasks.title: Establish Classic build and workflow baseline
tasks.acceptance: Run existing build/lint and record existing failures; exercise critical workflows only in a synthetic isolated profile with hosted connections disabled.

tasks.title: Rehearse code restore in a separate checkout
tasks.acceptance: Restore verified archive/bundle to a new exact directory, reconstruct dependencies, compare manifest and run baseline checks without overwriting the working project.

tasks.title: Prepare real-data backup and recovery prerequisites
tasks.acceptance: Document database, storage objects, auth/config and browser-local-data coverage, destinations, retention and post-backup-write reconciliation. No hosted backup executed under local permission; live recovery remains unverified until separately authorized.

tasks.title: Verify isolated synthetic database and recovery harness
tasks.acceptance: Use approved local database/runtime; test owning coach/client permissions and synthetic backup/restore. Failure or unavailable backend leaves backend verification incomplete, never substitutes a mocked permission test.

tasks.title: Specify Classic fallback and independent feature controls
tasks.acceptance: Map all changed entry points, R1/R2/R3 off defaults, schema compatibility and preservation of new records when disabled. Record explicit no-destructive-restore boundaries.

tasks.title: Accept local backup and build preflight
tasks.acceptance: Code archive and restore rehearsal pass; adequate storage/config coverage known; exact local runtime access resolved; sign-off gaps remain disabled. Record go/no-go for local implementation only.

tasks.title: Rehearse Classic fallback after the whole local build
tasks.acceptance: Test all new features off; test Classic code against additive synthetic schema and records written after migration; verify counts/references/actuals and failure containment. Diagnose incompatibility instead of claiming guaranteed rollback.
